summary: Pearson plc filed a Form 6-K on May 7, 2026, reporting PDMR share transactions under its Long-Term Incentive Plan. Several executives received releases of ADRs or ordinary shares upon vesting of LTIP awards, with one executive also selling shares to cover tax liabilities. No corporate event, M&A, or restructuring is involved. The filing is a routine disclosure of equity compensation vesting and associated share movements, not a special situation.
